**General**
- Zoom towards the mouse cursor is now optional for both the gfx view and texture editor
- Added a new Texture Editor section in the Settings dialog with the above setting
- Configuration files are now saved on applying changes in the Settings dialog, not only on exit
- Fixed node builder executable path not being saved in the Settings dialog
- [macOS] Fixed some issues with moving entries up/down in the list

**Texture Editor**
- Fixed changes not being saved when clicking 'Yes' on the prompt when the editor is closed with unsaved changes
- Fixed issues with the patch browser not appearing a second time for certain functions (eg. new texture from patch)
- The 'info overlay on hover' option has been moved to the Settings dialog
- Fixed loading of `TEXTURE1/2` with no `PNAMES` in the archive

**Map Editor**
- When merging sectors, any lines that had the same sector on both sides before the merge will no longer be removed
- Fixed wrong line length calculation for the 3d mode info overlay and wall textures
